title: Dual $(p,2)$ hypercontractivity from Hölder and a $(2,q)$ bound
statement:
Let $1 < p$ and $q \ge 2$ be conjugate exponents, so that $1/p + 1/q = 1$, let $\rho \in \bbr$, and let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function; write $\norm{g}_r = (\E[\abs{g}^r])^{1/r}$ for the $L^r$ norm under the uniform measure on the hypercube. Suppose Hölder's inequality holds for the exponent pair $(p,q)$, that is, $\langle u, v\rangle \le \norm{u}_p\,\norm{v}_q$ for all Boolean functions $u,v$, and suppose the noise operator satisfies the $(2,q)$ bound $\E\bigl[\abs{T_\rho g}^q\bigr] \le \bigl(\E[g^2]\bigr)^{q/2}$ for every Boolean function $g$. Then $T_\rho$ satisfies the dual $(p,2)$ bound
\[
  \bigl(\E[(T_\rho f)^2]\bigr)^{1/2} \le \bigl(\E[\,\abs{f}^p\,]\bigr)^{1/p}.
\]
replaced:
Let $1 < p$, $q \ge 2$ with $1/p + 1/q = 1$. Given a Hölder inequality for the pair
$(p,q)$ and a $(2,q)$-hypercontractivity bound for $T_\rho$, one concludes the dual
$(p,2)$ bound:
\[
  \bigl(\E[(T_\rho f)^2]\bigr)^{1/2} \le \bigl(\E[\,\abs{f}^p\,]\bigr)^{1/p}.
\]
